products.subtitle: Potash Derived From Rhodophytes (Flagship Product)
products.target_crops: Cash Crops, Vegetables, Fruit Crops, Legumes & Floriculture
products.target_crops_mr: रोख पिके, भाजीपाला, फळपिके, कडधान्ये व फुलशेती
products.shortDesc: Flagship bio-available potash derived from Rhodophytes enriched with natural minerals, auxins, and cytokinins to boost crop yield, sugar content, and drought resilience.
products.shortDesc_mr: नैसर्गिक खनिजे, ऑक्सिन्स आणि सायटोकायनिनने समृद्ध असलेले बायो-पोटॅश, जे पिकांचे उत्पादन, फळांमधील साखरेचे प्रमाण (Brix) आणि दुष्काळ प्रतिकारशक्ती वाढवते.
benefits: Contains bio-available potash which significantly improves vital plant functions.
Increases yield, weight, size, and quality of crop produce.
Helps activate growth-related enzymes and hormones naturally.
Improves crop resistance against severe drought and thermal stress.
Enhances root nutrient uptake efficiency across all growth stages.
Improves shape, uniform size, vibrant color, and rich flavor of produce.
Naturally rich in essential Minerals, Auxins, and Cytokinins.
benefits_mr: पिकाच्या आवश्यक शरीरक्रिया गतिमान करण्यास मदत करते.
उत्पादन, वजन, आकार आणि गुणवत्तेमध्ये लक्षणीय वाढ करते.
वाढीसाठी उपयुक्त विकर (enzymes) आणि हार्मोन्स नैसर्गिकरित्या सक्रिय करते.
दुष्काळ आणि तापमान बदलांविरुद्ध पिकाची प्रतिकारशक्ती वाढवते.
फळांचा आकर्षक रंग, चव आणि साखरेचे प्रमाण सुधारते.
products.specification: 100% Water Soluble Rhodophytes Potash extract with neutral pH.
products.usage: Suitable for Cash crops, Horticulture, Vegetables, Legumes, Cereals, Tuber & Bulb crops.
products.dosage: Foliar Spray: 1 - 1.5 gm per litre of water. Drip: 250 - 500 gm per acre.
products.precautions: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

products.subtitle: Flower & Fruit Enhancer
products.target_crops_mr: द्राक्षे, टोमॅटो, डाळिंब, मिरची व सर्व भाजीपाला
products.shortDesc: Specialized liquid flower and fruit enhancer formulated to prevent flower drop, promote uniform fruit setting, and maximize berry/fruit size.
products.shortDesc_mr: फुलगळ रोखण्यासाठी, एकसमान फळधारणेसाठी आणि फळांचा दर्जा सुधारण्यासाठी विशेष समुद्री अर्क.
benefits: Prevents premature flower and fruit drop under adverse weather.
Promotes uniform, profuse flowering and fruit development.
Enhances fruit size, skin shine, sugar content (Brix), and color.
Significantly increases marketable crop yield and shelf life.
benefits_mr: प्रतिकूल हवामानात फुलगळ व फळगळ थांबवते.
फुलांची संख्या आणि एकसमान फळधारणा वाढवते.
फळांचा आकार, चमक, साखर आणि वजन वाढवते.
products.specification: Concentrated Botanical & Marine Seaweed Extract Liquid.
products.usage: Spray during pre-flowering and fruit development stages.
products.precautions: Shake well before use. Compatible with common agrochemicals except strong alkaline sprays.

products.subtitle: Organic Manure
products.target_crops: All Agricultural, Horticultural and Plantation Crops
products.shortDesc: High-grade organic manure formulated to enrich soil texture, eliminate harmful contaminants, and boost crop immunity naturally.
products.shortDesc_mr: मातीचा पोत सुधारणारे, सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवणारे आणि पिकांची नैसर्गिक प्रतिकारशक्ती वाढवणारे सेंद्रिय खत.
benefits: Helps in eliminating unwanted and harmful soil contamination.
Enhances organic carbon content and microbial activity.
Improves soil water-holding capacity and aeration.
Supplies balanced macro and micro-nutrients sustainably.
benefits_mr: मातीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवून सुपीकता टिकवून ठेवते.
पाणी धरून ठेवण्याची क्षमता व हवा खेळती ठेवते.
products.specification: Enriched Organic Manure as per FCO specifications.
products.usage: Apply at the time of basal dose or before sowing/planting.
products.dosage: 100 - 200 kg per acre depending on soil fertility.
products.precautions: Store under shade. Mix well with soil during preparation.

products.subtitle: Enriched Bio-Organic Soil Conditioner
products.target_crops: Sugarcane, Cotton, Soybean, Onion & Fruit orchards
products.target_crops_mr: ऊस, कापूस, सोयाबीन, कांदा आणि फळबागा
products.shortDesc: Premium fermented organic soil revitalizer packed with humic substances and beneficial soil biology.
products.shortDesc_mr: ह्युमिक घटक आणि उपयुक्त सूक्ष्मजीवांनी समृद्ध सेंद्रिय खत.
benefits: Rapidly rehabilitates tired, chemically depleted farm soils.
Develops robust, deep root network.
Increases fertilizer uptake efficiency by over 30%.
products.usage: Basal dressing or top dressing along rows.
products.precautions: Ensure adequate moisture in soil after application.

products.subtitle: Diatomite Silicon Soil Amender
products.target_crops_mr: भात, ऊस, गहू, भाजीपाला व केळी
products.shortDesc: Natural diatomite silicon granules that provide structural strength to plant stems, protecting against pests, fungi, and lodging.
products.shortDesc_mr: पिकाच्या खोडाला मजबुती देणारे, कीड-रोगांपासून संरक्षण करणारे नैसर्गिक सिलिकॉन ग्रॅन्युल्स.
benefits: Strengthens stems, preventing crop lodging in heavy winds.
Creates a natural physical barrier against chewing pests and fungal hyphae.
Reduces transpiration water loss during hot summer days.
benefits_mr: पिकाचे खोड मजबूत करून पिके लोळण्यापासून वाचवते.
रोग आणि किडींच्या हल्ल्याविरुद्ध नैसर्गिक ढाल तयार करते.
उन्हाळ्यात पाण्याचा ताण सहन करण्यास मदत करते.
